surfaces.label: Bearer JWT validation and JWKS retrieval
surfaces.notes: Signature, issuer, audience, and algorithm controls fail closed, but the per-request cache lifecycle creates a reportable resource-amplification path.
surfaces.riskArea: Authentication availability and outbound identity-provider resource use

surfaces.label: Tokenless loopback launcher principal
surfaces.notes: Marker and loopback peer checks reject direct remote clients, but no application-layer Host, Origin, or launcher capability binds browser requests.
surfaces.riskArea: Local authorization boundary and browser-origin trust

surfaces.label: UPN role parsing and reviewer identity bridge
surfaces.notes: Unknown roles are dropped and route guards are enforced, but domain removal creates a collision-prone workflow key.
surfaces.riskArea: Principal uniqueness, reviewer separation, and workflow-state attribution
